actors.name: McCain campaign
actors.private_context: The McCain campaign has received an invitation to the first presidential debate at the University of Mississippi on September 26, 2008. They have not yet publicly confirmed participation. They are considering the terms and logistics.

actors.name: Obama campaign
actors.private_context: The Obama campaign has received an invitation to the first presidential debate at the University of Mississippi on September 26, 2008. They have not yet publicly confirmed participation. They are considering the terms and logistics.

shared_context: The Commission on Presidential Debates has scheduled the first presidential debate for September 26, 2008, at the University of Mississippi. Both campaigns have been formally invited. Public confirmation of participation is expected before the debate date. The debate is a major media event.

starting_events.description: The McCain and Obama campaigns have received invitations to the first presidential debate. Neither has publicly confirmed participation.

resolution: Resolve YES if, before the hard cutoff, both the McCain campaign and the Obama campaign have issued a public statement (e.g., press release, official announcement) confirming their candidate's participation in the debate. Resolve NO otherwise.
